profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.summary:
I am a first-generation college graduate, software engineer, and a Chinese immigrant. When the pandemic hit and the world shut down, I had the opportunity to do what I love most, learn. Through the Stanford Code in Place class, Udemy, and Coursera, I acquired expertise in Python, SQL, and Advanced Excel. Most importantly, I discovered my passion for software engineering. 

What truly inspired me to take a leap of faith and pursue a career in software engineering was due to my inability to locate COVID-19 vaccines for my family members. When the vaccine was first available, it was a major struggle for anyone to locate available appointments. Fortunately, I found out about TurboVax, a website built by an Asian American, like myself. The website consolidated all available appointments from various mediums to streamline the process. The website itself only cost him 50 dollars to build. TurboVax has helped hundreds of thousands of New Yorkers, including my own family, to schedule vaccination appointments. After seeing how a single person can utilize software engineering to build a product with tremendous impact, I was truly inspired. 

Upon my graduation from Fullstack Academy, I look forward to exploring full stack engineering positions where I can be part of a team that provides mentorship and empowerment to help build applications that will make a positive impact on our community.

Technologies 

Proficient: JavaScript, Node.js, React/Redux, Git, Express, Sequelize, PostgreSQL, HTML5,  Microsoft Office

Knowledgeable: CSS3, Python, Tableau, Google Analytics

Familiar: TDD (Jasmine, Mocha, Chai), Babel, Webpack, Heroku, Agile

positions.title: Future Code Fellow at Fullstack Academy
positions.description: 28-Week immersive software engineering program based in New York City, in partnership with Workforce 1, NYC Small Business Services, and Tech Talent Pipeline, centered on full-stack Javascript development, including Node.js, Express, Sequelize ORM for PostgreSQL databases, React and Redux: along with HTML5, CSS3, and CS fundamentals.

positions.title: Sales Consultant
positions.description:
• Evaluated clients' needs to best negotiate pricing and financing options, achieved and exceeded the company's monthly sales objective of 8 cars per month by averaging 12 car sales a month
• Demonstrated car functions to clients, described options, and explained related purchasing costs while maintained a well above average customer satisfaction of 95% over all car deals
• Cultivated interpersonal relationships with new and prior clients through in-person and digital leads, routinely followed up with information regarding inventory availability, options and prices to drive greater sales numbers

positions.title: Data Analytics Apprentice
positions.description:
• Acquired technical skills in Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP), SQL, Tableau, Salesforce, Power BI and Programmatic through a 200+ hour intensive apprenticeship in data comprehension and storytelling
• Analyzed data sets, presented data visualizations, and made insights on projects throughout the semester through the use of Tableau, PowerPoint, and Excel
• Strengthened interpersonal skills with cohort of 16 members through team building exercises, presentations, and networking events

positions.title: Summer Legal Intern
positions.description:
• Coordinated a team of 3 to collect and analyze research on several new legal issues and composed presentations on relevant cases and seminars for the law office’s clients
• Spearheaded a seminar of 30-40 clients with a panel of lawyers informing about the newly effective PAID program to ensure clients are aware of how these laws beneficially affect them 
• Reviewed and evaluated medical records, liabilities and damages with lawyers to formulate 6-10 demand packages for personal injury cases 
• Streamlined audits through learning Excel by analyzing the recordings of plaintiff’s time sheets and transactions of employees into well-organized spreadsheets

company.name: Law Offices of Doo and Chong

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description:
• Tutored a classroom of 20 children on course material by figuring out various teaching methods that worked best for each student resulting in increases of 20 - 30% in standardized test scores
• Developed various techniques to interact with campers between ages of 8-10 by observing behavioral tendencies in order to communicate instructions in ways they can comprehend

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
•	Collaborated in a team of 10 marketing team members in brainstorming and constructing advertisement posters 
•	Guided and participated in 6-8 community events to continue publicizing the Sing Tao brand
•	Liaised with Marketing Manager and Chief Marketing Officer and sought feedback and input on tasks as assigned
